items.title: 1. Body surface is a noisy hull, not planes
items.evidence: 1_beauty back34/az090 flank and rump are calmer but still show many small light-catching facets; 2_closeups hind limb wire is still fan/triangle soup, not 6-8 big planes.

items.title: 2. Hind legs are pillars: no hock, no heel, no foot
items.evidence: 1_beauty az090 hind leg has a stepped rear edge and forward foot block, but no visible hock angle; shin still reads as a near-vertical slab (3_tech az090 same).

items.title: 3. Hind-leg dark paint jagged and grey
items.evidence: 1_beauty az090 and back34: one horizontal dark border at matching height on hind and front legs, no dark tongue up the thigh; dark reads warm brown.

items.title: 4. Front legs not separated from chest
items.evidence: 1_beauty hero/az000: front legs still drop straight out of the chest with a dark seam, no shoulder mass or shadow gap; 3_tech az000 shows purple/teal defects at the chest cleft between the legs.

items.title: 5. Attack clip does not read as an attack
items.evidence: 4_posed attack_f010/f020: body leans forward/down and one paw is off the ground reaching forward, clearly different from idle; but the paw is low under the chin, not at chest height swept across, and head is not raised.
